subject: Request: short pilot buffer while PO routes

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short pilot buffer while PO routes

Hi Arman —

Quick note from our side: we saw the PO draft come through (thanks) and understand procurement needs a few business days to route internally. The Cygnus team has active integrations running in the pilot and we want to avoid interruptions while finance completes the PO.

Could we put a short 7‑day buffer in place so your team retains full access? Options we can do immediately:
- apply a 2,000 token voucher for one week, or
- extend the existing pilot window by 7 days on the current project id.

Attached is the latest PO draft and the pilot scope doc for reference. If you prefer, I can have our finance lead approve the voucher and issue it today.

Happy to keep this narrow — if you confirm which option you'd prefer and the nominal end date you'd like, we'll take care of the rest.

Thanks,
Rachel

Rachel Kim

rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0119

1) Can you confirm the voucher amount in tokens (helps our usage forecasting)?
2) Please confirm the voucher start and end dates.

I'll copy Susan in procurement so she has visibility; she may flag if finance needs a short internal memo.

Appreciate the quick support — this pilot has been useful for internal stakeholders.
